question: What VALUE types may be written into a text include

routes.reasoning_given: The product owner ruled that the contract gives no such refusal
routes.route: Any VALUE on an LF target (non-strings written as typed); refuse only a non-string for a CRLF target. Reworked from an early draft that refused mappings and lists
Only strings (otherwise exit 3); CRLF endings of the target are preserved
